cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: A Kinder Version
cards.instruction: Protect someone from the full truth by offering a carefully edited explanation that feels kinder than complete honesty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. The gallery thinks your portrait would suit a more adventurous exhibition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're showing a fridge full of teeth. What did they say about mine?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. That the face doesn't immediately reveal what you intended.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's you. They called it unrecognisable, didn't they?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: They think knowing the sitter would help. I'll attend your next opening with a matching shirt.

mechanism: A authorizes only a softened account of criticism and prescribes a helpful response instead of admitting the full insult.
confusable: Unlike praising vaguely, A edits each newly specified criticism to protect the painter while controlling what may be heard.
comparison: A portrait of A permits a concrete matching-shirt remedy, unlike a friend's exclusion from a dinner.
seedUse: Use adventurous gallery, unrecognizable face and sitter reveal; make S01 govern the permitted feedback and offered help.
